leadText:
Pokémon Horizons: The Series is the first season of the dubbed version of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It is the twenty-sixth season of the Pokémon animated series. The season follows Liko and Roy as they travel around the with a group of adventurers known as the Rising Volt Tacklers.

In , episodes were added on Netflix beginning on March 7, 2024 and concluding on November 22, 2024. In , it debuted on December 1, 2023 on BBC iPlayer and on December 4, 2023 on CBBC. In , it debuted on February 27, 2024 on 9Go!. In , it debuted on March 2, 2024 on Cartoon Network. In Asia, it debuted on March 8, 2024 on the Pokémon Asia ENG YouTube channel. In sub-Saharan Africa, it debuted on March 25, 2024 on Cartoon Network Africa. In , it debuted on April 15, 2024 on Netflix.

It is preceded by Pokémon Ultimate Journeys: The Series, the last season of the previous animated series in the West, , and succeeded by Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua. It comprises the Liko and Roy's Departure and The Sparkling of Terapagos arcs from the Japanese version.

Pokémon Horizons: The Series is the first season of the dubbed version of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It is the twenty-sixth season of the Pokémon animated series. The season follows Liko and Roy as they travel around the with a group of adventurers known as the Rising Volt Tacklers.

In , episodes were added on Netflix beginning on March 7, 2024 and concluding on November 22, 2024. In , it debuted on December 1, 2023 on BBC iPlayer and on December 4, 2023 on CBBC. In , it debuted on February 27, 2024 on 9Go!. In , it debuted on March 2, 2024 on Cartoon Network. In Asia, it debuted on March 8, 2024 on the Pokémon Asia ENG YouTube channel. In sub-Saharan Africa, it debuted on March 25, 2024 on Cartoon Network Africa. In , it debuted on April 15, 2024 on Netflix.

It is preceded by Pokémon Ultimate Journeys: The Series, the last season of the previous animated series in the West, , and succeeded by Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua. It comprises the Liko and Roy's Departure and The Sparkling of Terapagos arcs from the Japanese version.

==Blurb==
 A new adventure is beginning within the wide world of Pokémon! Arriving at Indigo Academy, a girl named Liko receives her first partner Pokémon, Sprigatito. But she soon finds herself pursued by the Explorers, a mysterious group that’s determined to take the pendant necklace she wears. Liko isn’t on her own, though, as Friede, Captain Pikachu and the other Rising Volt Tacklers offer her protection aboard their airship. Meanwhile, a boy named Roy dreams of becoming a Pokémon Trainer, unaware of the secret hiding within the Ancient Poké Ball he carries. As Liko, Roy and the Rising Volt Tacklers set sail for new horizons, what kind of discoveries await?

The Rising Volt Tacklers encounter Amethio and his cohorts again. (HZ022)
Liko and Roy encounter Lucius's third Pokémon, a . (HZ022)

Roy and Friede meet Liko's grandmother, Diana, for the first time. (HZ024)
The Rising Volt Tacklers learn that the mysterious Pokémon is called . (HZ024)
Amethio, Onia, and Zirc arrive at Diana's castle and prepare to attack the Rising Volt Tacklers. (HZ024)
Liko and Roy encounter Sidian and Coral for the first time. (HZ025)
Diana starts traveling with the Rising Volt Tacklers. (HZ025)
Diana reveals that Lucius's last three Pokémon are , , and . (HZ025)

The Rising Volt Tacklers set out to find the remaining members of Lucius's Six Heroes. (HZ026)
The Explorers decide to go after the Black Rayquaza. (HZ027)
A and join the Rising Volt Tacklers. (HZ030)
The Rising Volt Tacklers find Lucius's fourth Pokémon, a . (HZ031)

Amethio battles the Black Rayquaza and is defeated. (HZ033)
transforms into its for the first time on-screen. (HZ033)
Diana reveals to Friede that she intends to travel alone again. (HZ033)
Liko and Roy have a training with Diana, which ends after they complete their objective of trying to land a single hit. (HZ033)
Amethio returns to the Explorers' base and requests to train with Hamber. (HZ033)
The Explorers are revealed to be looking for Laqua. (HZ034)
Amethio receives a Tera Orb from Hamber. (HZ034)
Diana leaves the Rising Volt Tacklers. (HZ034)
The Rising Volt Tacklers decide to return to Paldea. (HZ034)
A family joins the Rising Volt Tacklers. (HZ038)
Liko and Roy meet Franka, Dot's mother and Murdock's sister, for the first time. (HZ041)
Dot reveals to Liko and Roy the story of how she joined the Rising Volt Tacklers. (HZ041)
Dot s Franka and wins. (HZ041)
The Rising Volt Tacklers arrive back in Paldea. (HZ042)
Friede is informed of the existence of a mysterious tower. (HZ042)
Liko and Roy cross paths with the Explorers again and have a Multi Battle with Coral and Sidian, which is called off. (HZ043)
The Explorers are revealed to be planning to summon and capture the Black Rayquaza. (HZ043)
Friede meets Spinel in person for the first time and has another against him. (HZ044)
The Explorers begin their operation to capture the Black Rayquaza. (HZ044)
The Rising Volt Tacklers confront the Explorers to stop their plan. (HZ044)
The Brave Olivine suffers major damage when the Black Rayquaza is sent crashing into it. (HZ044)
Spinel, Coral, Sidian, and Chalce retreat. (HZ045)
Amethio uses stallization for the first time. (HZ045)
Amethio and the Rising Volt Tacklers battle against the Black Rayquaza, but they are all defeated. (HZ045)
Liko, Roy, and Dot decide they want to learn more about the Terastal phenomenon. (HZ045)
Gibeon orders the Explorers admins to continue monitoring Liko and while waiting for the Rising Volt Tacklers to gather the Six Heroes. (HZ045)

==Episodes==
 
 

==Trivia==
This is the first season:
not to feature and as main protagonists and the Team Rocket trio as main antagonists.
to use direct translations of the Japanese titles for most of the English titles of episodes.
where the English dub uses different opening themes for different releases of the same episodes depending on the country, with Becoming Me for the international release and We Go (English Ver.) for the Asian release.
to be promoted with more than two official posters. Each of the four posters corresponds to a batch of episodes released consecutively in March, May, August, and November 2024.
not to feature James Carter Cathcart as a cast member in the English dub, after retiring from the animated series at the end of due to him been diagnosed with a throat cancer and undergoing treatment.
The season was initially announced to be releasing in and internationally on February 23, 2024, but was later delayed till March 7, 2024. .
In Asian territories where The Pokémon Company holds distribution rights, this season is also numbered as season 26 of the Pokémon animated series as a whole. 
However, The Pokémon Company International exclusively refers to this season as the first of a new, separate series different from the previous animated series. This includes referring to the show as the "new Pokémon animated series" in pre-release material, starting the numbering from Season 1, and using "Pokémon the Series" in social media material of prior episodes after this point.
